description: Stop a module's pods (scale to 0), remembering how many it ran; unfreeze_module starts them again. Freezing a frozen module changes nothing. One operation runs on a module at a time, and none beside an operation on its project: the refusal names the running job; wait for it with get_job_status, then call again. While RationalBloks is being updated, the call is refused with 'RationalBloks is being updated': call it again in a few minutes.
name: freeze_module
title: Freeze Module
